testimonial.intro: Push Pull Legs with Mike already has several satisfied users.
testimonial.quote: My brother Mike built a fitness app. I wish I was joking. For months, he’s dragged me to the gym, talked my ear off, and flexed in every mirror we pass. Annoying? Absolutely. The app is actually okay, though. You can easily create and customize your workouts. Completely free, with zero ads and no subscriptions.

beta.metaTitle: Mike Needs Your Help – Push Pull Legs with Mike
beta.title: Mike Needs Your Help
beta.p1: Before the app can be published, a group of testers has to test it on their phones for a period of two weeks. Google isn't keen on revealing how often you actually have to use the app. Four times should probably be enough.
beta.p2: Since Mike has no friends, it would be really nice of you to help out. Mike will be grateful to you forever!
beta.p3: First, you need to join the Google Group. Then you can download the app from the store. Sorry that it's so complicated, but that's Google's requirement.
